author_name: สีดา อริศ
text:
Jack Cummins 

Is Pimsleur a language learning app? I wasn’t familiar with it before. Thank you very much for recommending it. I also have a book that I haven’t finished yet. Once I complete it I’ll check the books you mentioned.Honestly, my biggest obstacle is laziness. When I feel motivated I try to read and even sound out signs everywhere, but when I get tired from work I end up studying much less.🥲 Thank you for the reminder. it was very accurate and helpful advice.🙏🙏🙏
